id: \bMiltank are so great. They make the best milk. Try some.
en: \bMiltank are so great. They make the best milk. Try some.
it: \bI Miltank sono fantastici. Fanno il latte migliore. Assaggialo.
\bQuesto sì che è latte di qualità.

id: \bWe aren't taking any passengers right now. Sorry.
en: \bWe aren't taking any passengers right now. Sorry.
it: \bAl momento non accettiamo passeggeri. Mi dispiace.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?

id: \rLillie: Everyone else already left to explore. I guess I'll just look around town. There are no Pokémon after all.
en: \rLillie: Everyone else already left to explore. I guess I'll just look around town. There are no Pokémon after all.
it: \rLylia: Gli altri sono già andati in esplorazione. Credo che farò un giro in città. Dopotutto qui non ci sono Pokémon.

id: \bHave you been to the ranch? They have all kinds of cool things there.
en: \bHave you been to the ranch? They have all kinds of cool things there.
it: \bSei stato al ranch? Hanno un sacco di cose forti lì.

id: \bKukui: There you are \PN. I figured a good trial for you to attempt would be the one at Brooklet Hill.
en: \bKukui: There you are \PN. I figured a good trial for you to attempt would be the one at Brooklet Hill.
it: \bKukui: Eccoti qui, \PN. Ho pensato che una buona prova da tentare per te fosse quella della Collina Ruscello.

id: \bWell, assuming Lana doesn't beat you there. She loves Water Pokémon after all.
en: \bWell, assuming Lana doesn't beat you there. She loves Water Pokémon after all.
it: \bSempre che Suiren non ti batta sul tempo. Dopotutto adora i Pokémon d'acqua.

id: \bWell assuming Lana doesn't beat you there. She loves water Pokémon after all.
en: \bWell assuming Lana doesn't beat you there. She loves water Pokémon after all.
it: \bSempre che Suiren non ti batta sul tempo. Dopotutto adora i Pokémon d'acqua.

id: \bKukui: So you beat your trial? I guess that ends our trip. I'll see you at home.
en: \bKukui: So you beat your trial? I guess that ends our trip. I'll see you at home.
it: \bKukui: Allora hai superato la tua prova? Direi che il nostro viaggio finisce qui. Ci vediamo a casa.

id: \bKiawe: I'll meet you at the ranch.
en: \bKiawe: I'll meet you at the ranch.

id: \rWant a fishing tip? Go pay someone to do it for you.
en: \rWant a fishing tip? Go pay someone to do it for you.
it: \rVuoi un consiglio sulla pesca? Paga qualcuno che lo faccia al posto tuo.

id: Paniola Town\nThe town we developed with our Pokémon.
en: Paniola Town\nThe town we developed with our Pokémon.
it: Paniola\nLa città che abbiamo costruito con i nostri Pokémon.
